resources.string: Edit GTA text files on your phone.
Open a .gxt file, find the line you need, edit it, then export a fresh copy.
Load a sample to poke around
Tap a token to insert it
A small, native GXT editor for Grand Theft Auto text files.

GXT files connect short keys to the text shown in game. Open a file, tap an entry, make your change, and export a rebuilt copy. San Andreas uses CRC32 keys; readable names depend on the bundled name list.
Tokens control colour, line breaks, placeholders, and controls in game text. Keep the ones you still need while editing.
